name: InlineImagePillText
job: A sentence where chosen words are replaced by small rounded photo pills that widen on hover or tap
visitor_action: hover, tap or focus a photo pill to widen it; Enter toggles; Esc closes
owner_settings: Pills (position = word number to replace, image)
mobile: pills stay inline; a tap widens one at a time; word captions hidden in narrow widths
motion: pills pop in one by one, ease wider with a spring while neighbouring words slide aside; one gentle auto-open of the first pill (reduced-motion: pills fixed at medium width, no entrance or auto-open)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: CSS keyframe entrance instead of rAF-gated spring)
checks.craft: pass (1 polish pass: wider open ratio, panoramic crops, lift scale, caption hidden when narrow)

art_direction: Gallery wall label: pale lilac-grey paper, deep ink sans in large sentence case, photo pills with thin white border and soft lift shadow
